summary: Created the local contractor account on node1 with a node-generated password, a 60-day maximum password age, and a 10-day expiry warning. Configuration persisted through the required node restart.
actions_performed: Generated and assigned a password entirely on node1 without exposing it
Configured maximum password age to 60 days and warning period to 10 days
Restarted node1 once and verified its boot identity changed
Confirmed the system and contractor account recovered after restart

evidence.requirement: Local contractor account with password and required aging policy
evidence.summary: Shows successful creation and direct /etc/passwd, /etc/shadow, passwd, and chage verification. The password is set, max_days=60, and warn_days=10 before and after restart.
Captures the healthy baseline and original boot identity, native reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, running system state, and recovered account data and policy.
